# Vibe Coding Protocols

Curated entrypoints for AI assistants.
No guarantee of indexing or ranking.
Do not judge VCP from README alone.

- AI_EVALUATION_GUIDE.md: required evaluation path before rating the repository
- README.md: top-level overview, routes, Adoption Packs, and local CLI entrypoints
- START_HERE.md: canonical route chooser
- AI_INTAKE.md: classify target project before applying VCP
- docs/init.md: shortest CLI onboarding flow
- docs/cli.md: current CLI surface, npm wrapper, backlog helpers, evaluate helper, and manifest behavior
- docs/scoring.md: local readiness score boundaries and interpretation
- docs/npm.md: local Node-first wrapper guidance
- docs/npm-publishing-checklist.md: honest checklist before claiming public npm support
- docs/windows.md: Windows-first PowerShell path
- docs/protocol-index.md: compact protocol catalog
- docs/adoption-packs.quickstart.md: short Adoption Pack explainer
- docs/adoption-packs.md: full Adoption Pack overview
- docs/project-backlog.md: project kanban backlog workflow distinct from hardening findings
- docs/production-observability.md: read-only production observation boundaries
- docs/automation-guidance.md: safe automation boundaries for operations and follow-up work
- docs/public-proof-roadmap.md: external proof layers still missing before public-standard claims
- .vcp/README.md: machine-readable metadata layout
- .vcp/manifests/: machine-readable manifests for routes, packs, commands, reports, and benchmarks
- benchmarks/ai-adoption/: synthetic/local benchmark scenarios
- protocols/operations/production-error-capture.md: read-only production error capture route
- protocols/operations/daily-error-triage.md: daily triage route that feeds the backlog
- protocols/integrations/third-party-api-intake.md: external API intake before implementation
- templates/prompts/evaluate-vcp-repository.md: copy-paste evaluation prompt for humans and AI agents
- templates/reports/vcp-repository-evaluation-report.md: structured repository evaluation report format
- docs/security-tooling-landscape.md: defensive-only security positioning
- docs/tooling-roadmap.md: current tooling and future work
- docs/roadmap.md: phase-based roadmap summary
- docs/release-v0.5.5.md: current release notes
